title: The explicit upper-tail base-change cone is limiting
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R : I -> CommRingCat a diagram and c a limiting cone of R.op followed by Spec. Fix i in I and any g : A -> Spec(R_i). Define upperTailSpectrumOver on J.op, J = {j | i <= j}, by Spec(R_j) -> Spec(R_i), and upperTailSpectrumOverCone by the legs of c. Define upperTailChartDiagram and upperTailChartCone by pulling this diagram and cone back along g in the slice and then forgetting to Scheme. The explicitly constructed cone is limiting. The underlying vertex is the actual pullback of c.pi_i and g; no existential witness supplies any definition.

proof.text: Construct the spectrum diagram and its cone in the slice using R.map and c.w. The displayed diagram and cone are then literal images under Over.pullback g and Over.forget A, not choices from a theorem.

J is nonempty (i belongs to it) and directed. Its inclusion t in I is final by Monotone.final_functor_iff, since every k has a common upper bound with i. Functor.Initial.isLimitWhiskerEquiv restricts hc along t.op. Identify the underlying slice cone with that restriction through the identity-component natural isomorphism. The forgetful functor reflects limits, giving the limiting slice cone. Over.pullback g is a right adjoint and preserves limits. IsCofiltered.isConnected and preservation of connected limits by the slice forgetful functor finish the proof.

proof_origin.place: R3 second reading: explicit pullback construction, cofinality and preservation/reflection of limits; fully proved.
